title: ClearFront: reproducible bundle extraction to editable baseline
description: Operator directive hcom #311 (2026-07-16): take over ClearFront trading card game via MAP. First step per Lilo's intake handoff (MAP_System/handoffs/HANDOFF-CLEARFRONT-intake-codex-lab-lilo-to-claude-lab-gome.md): the original Clearfront.html is a generated self-extracting artifact-bundler HTML (JSON __bundler/manifest of UUID-keyed base64/gzip assets + JSON __bundler/template with UUID placeholders), not editable source. Original preserved+hashed under Projects/ClearFront/source/ (done). Write a reproducible Python extractor that parses the manifest+template, decodes/decompresses every asset to a real file, rewrites template UUID references to relative asset paths, and emits a runnable baseline HTML outside source/. Prove parity with a smoke test before any decomposition/refactor begins (RISK-CF-0001).
acceptance_criteria: Extractor script decodes every __bundler/manifest entry (asset count matches manifest key count) to real files under baseline/assets/, decompressing gzip entries.
Extracted baseline HTML has all UUID placeholders replaced with relative paths to real files (zero raw UUID strings remain in the emitted HTML).
__bundler/ext_resources entries are enumerated and accounted for in the extraction report, not silently dropped.
Smoke test documents that the extracted baseline renders/behaves equivalently to the original bundle (screenshot or DOM/console check), recorded in artifacts/tests/task-extraction-parity.md.
source/ remains untouched; extraction reads from source/ only.
